description: Defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_BoolToCSS that converts a boolean attribute into a fixed CSS style within an HTML purifier's attribute transformation process.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_BoolToCSS
classes.description: A pre-transform class that alters boolean HTML attributes into specific CSS styles by removing the attribute and injecting CSS rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute name to transform and the CSS to apply.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attributes by removing the specified boolean attribute and prepending CSS styles if the attribute exists.
